paragraphs: Shall I tell you about my family? My name is May. I am ten years old. I live in the white house next to the school. Mom, Dad, Grandma, my brother Pat, and I live there. My mom works at the library. She has black hair and a white band in her hair. She has a big green bag with many books in it. My dad works at the market, and he gets up very early. Grandma has short gray hair and a blue shirt. She has a big red bowl. She makes hot soup for us.

My brother Pat is seven years old. He is small, but he is very brave. Pat has a big toy box. At the bottom of the box, there is a red hat. There is a funny mustache, too. Pat puts it on and says, "Look, I am a famous man!" We all laugh because he looks so funny. He has many toys. But he puts nothing back in the box. "Shall I help you, Pat?" asks Grandma.

We have one more friend at home. He is a green parrot called Bill. Bill lives in a cage near the window. He is famous in our street because he talks to everyone. Every morning he says, "Good morning!" to Mom. Bill has food and water in two cups. He likes Grandma's soup. But he must not have it. Our house is small, but it is full of noise and fun. Who is in your family? What animal do you have at home?
text.summary: May writes a page about her family. She tells us about her mom, her grandma, her brother Pat, and their green parrot, Bill.
